source.instruction: Tambahkan kebutuhan ini sebagai scope tersendiri di backlog. Kerjakan sebagai paket berikutnya setelah blok integrasi aktif stabil; pertahankan kandidat dan pengujian yang sedang berjalan. A tetap integrator tunggal.

scope: Use normal sales with customer type Toko or Mandor; attach posted FG invoice receivable to the identified mandor and manually selected payroll week.
UI: Existing source-card pattern with invoice, date, value, outstanding, allocations, free balance and assigned payroll/week; amount selection and net-pay preview; desktop and mobile.
identity: Use master mandor ID, never name matching.
draft_payroll: Reserve available invoice amount; do not settle receivable yet.
paid_payroll: Atomically settle that same invoice receivable through payroll deduction; pay only net cash/bank; preserve existing wage expense recognition.
limits: Invoice free outstanding after all active payroll reservations, payments and returns
Server concurrency, current permissions, request idempotency and source-version review
history: Unassigning or cancelling unpaid payroll releases its reservation
Reversing paid payroll restores linked settlement through lawful reversal
Invoice return/cancel follows existing rules and requires refreshed deduction review or named blocking transactions
Preserve stock, HPP/COGS, posting, physical/system dates and append-only source history
future_evidence_scope: Owner2m/300k example and manually selected other week
Partial payment, remaining balance and allocations across two payrolls
Balance change through payment or return
Unassign, cancel, linked reversal and downstream blockers
Ordinary customer sale regression; stock/HPP recorded once; expense/settlement not duplicated
Actual Auth and normal App source-card journeys on desktop and mobile
